Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on estimating historical and current soil organic carbon (SOC) stocks and their changes in Irish agricultural soils from 1990 to 2014. It does not include any future land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. While it uses historical LULC data (LPIS 2000–2014) as input to assess SOC dynamics, its primary objective is carbon stock quantification—not LULC modeling. It fails core inclusion criteria because it lacks implementation of ≥2 future LULC scenarios, does not produce mapped LULC projections, and contains no predictive LULC component. It also meets exclusion criteria as it is a biomass/carbon study without LULC change analysis beyond using observed historical land use.)
